task: Availability rules: when each good and resource feature becomes visible
open_questions: Food shown at Voltara at start (scarce there, buy 30, real route to Tillam/Ashgate); ore/dross/plate hidden although Voltara prices them. Veto?
chips/silk/rivets/musk/spores have no unlock node; I gate them on system 2 open (permit). Rivets and musk/spores have a system-1 buy price, so a purist could show them earlier.
'Space station' does not exist; I mapped it to Space Storage (FND_STORAGE).
handoff: data/availability.json written (rules + atoms + start_state). Start at Voltara: VISIBLE energy, food. HIDDEN: ore (needs FND_PROSPECT), dross (MIN_3 + cycle 15), nullglass (MIN_5 + cycle 15 + system 2), plate (Fabric built), chips/silk/rivets/musk/spores (system 2 open), cells/armour/cask/gems/ingot/alloy/gel/seed (good unlock AND workshop built). Workshops: shown when unlocking node learned (MIN_1 fabric+smelter, MIL_1, LUX_1, BIO_1). Space Storage UI: FND_STORAGE learned. Owned stock always shows (stock_held). Rule paragraph: Availability rule: never show a resource, workshop or storage feature before its visible_when in data/availability.json is true. That file is the single source for what the UI shows and when; do not hard-code unlocks elsewhere. New goods, workshops or storage features need a rule there first. The availability test must pass before any UI change is handed off.
